_comment: Two defect classes on the section-landing tiles. First, content loss: the disconnected-tokens description collapsed from a full sentence explaining what the page does into the two-word noun phrase 離線權杖 ('offline tokens'), so the tile restated its own heading and told the operator nothing -- and it used 權杖 where the rest of this pack says 令牌. Second, English residue: five leaves ship raw untranslated English inside a Traditional Chinese pack, which passes the key-parity gate because the key exists and is non-empty. A Taiwanese operator opening these section landings reads English group titles and English descriptions with translated headings above them. Translated using this pack's own wording -- 認證資料 for credentials, 提升權限 for elevation, 令牌 for token. AGENT DRAFTS -- native review still required.

source.sectionLanding.desc.disconnected_tokens: Mint or exchange tokens so an agent can elevate while disconnected.

source.sectionLanding.groupDesc.configuration_s: Agent settings are what endpoints receive; server settings apply to this host only.
source.sectionLanding.groupDesc.lab_advanced: Advanced lab surfaces for discovery and drills.
